card.line: Ramathaim-zophim was a city in the hill country of Ephraim, and it was the hometown of Elkanah, the husband of Hannah, in the story that begins 1 Samuel.

moments.title: Elkanah's hometown
moments.text: 1 Samuel begins by telling us that Elkanah, an Ephraimite, was from Ramathaim-zophim in the hill country of Ephraim. His family line is listed back through Jeroham, Elihu, Tohu, and Zuph.

moments.title: Yearly trips to Shiloh
moments.text: Year after year Elkanah went up from his city to worship and sacrifice to the LORD of Hosts at Shiloh. Each time, Hannah, who had no children, was taunted by her rival until she wept and would not eat.
